## Why This Is Asked

Tests end-to-end image provenance across multi-cloud GPU workloads, combining CI, runtime policies, and verification in real-world constraints.

## Key Concepts

- Image provenance, Cosign, Sigstore, reproducible builds
- Kubernetes admission control (Kyverno/OPA)
- Buildx/OCI digests and registry security
- GPU workload constraints and cross-cloud policy

## Code Example

```yaml
# GitHub Actions: build, sign, verify
name: BuildSignVerify
on: [push]
jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up QEMU/Buildx
      - name: Build and push
        run: |
          docker buildx create --use
          image=registry.example.com/project/image:${{ github.sha }}
          docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 \
            -t $image --build-arg BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE=1 .
          cosign sign -key cosign.key $image
          docker push $image
      - name: Verify signature
        run: cosign verify -key cosign.pub $image
```

```yaml
# Kyverno policy (example)
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata:
  name: require-signed-image
spec:
  validationFailureAction: fail
  rules:
  - name: check-cosign-signature
    match:
      resources:
        kinds: [Deployment]
    verifyImages:
    - image: registry.example.com/*
      pattern: "^.+$"
```

```yaml
# Sample failing manifest (unsigned image)
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: guest-deploy
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: app
        image: registry.example.com/project/image:unsigned

```

```yaml
# Sample passing manifest (signed image with digest)
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: secure-deploy
spec:
  template:
    metadata:
      annotations:
        build.sha256: "abcdef123456..."
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: app
        image: registry.example.com/project/image:sha-abcdef
```

- How would you test policy changes across multiple clusters with blue/green deployments?
- What are failure modes if cosign keys rotate or GitOps sync lags?

kind: AuthorizationPolicy
metadata:

```yaml
# Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate (pseudo)
apiVersion: templates.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: ConstraintTemplate
metadata:
  name: k8sspiffe
spec:
  crd:
    spec:
      names:
        kind: SPIFFEIsTenantScoped
  targets:
  - target: admission.k8s.gatekeeper.sh
    rego: |
      package k8sspiffe
      violation[{"msg": msg}] {
        input.review.kind.kind == "Pod"
        not input.review.object.metadata.annotations["spiffe-id"]

      }
```

Why This Is Asked
- Tests ability to translate governance requirements into concrete, enforceable policies and CI steps. 
- Combines data catalog metadata with image provenance and basic security gates in a beginner-friendly way.

Key Concepts
- Policy as code (Kyverno/OPA Gatekeeper)
- Annotations for data governance (data-catalog.uri)
- Image provenance (digest pinning, registry allowlist)
- Basic hardening (forbidden hostNetwork/hostPath, non-privileged)
- Namespace quotas and network policies

Code Example
```yaml
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: governance-baseline
spec:
  rules:
  - name: require-data-catalog
    match:
      resources:
        kinds: ["Deployment", "StatefulSet"]
    validate:
      message: "data.catalog.uri annotation required"
      pattern:
        metadata:
          annotations:
            data.catalog.uri: "?*"
  - name: require-image-digest
    match:
      resources:
        kinds: ["Deployment", "StatefulSet"]
    validate:
      message: "image must be pinned with digest"
      pattern:
        spec:
          template:
            spec:
              containers:
              - image: "*@sha256:*"
  - name: disallow-risky-fields
    match:
      resources:
        kinds: ["Pod", "Deployment", "StatefulSet"]
    prune: false
    validate:
      message: "hostNetwork/hostPath/privileged not allowed"
      pattern:
        spec:
          hostNetwork: False
        volumes: []
```

Failing Manifest (example)

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: data-processor
  namespace: team-a
spec:
  replicas: 1

      hostNetwork: true
      volumes:
        - name: data
          hostPath:
            path: /data
      containers:
        - name: processor
          image: registry.internal/data-processor:latest
```

Passing Manifest (example)

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: data-processor

    data.catalog.uri: "https://catalog.example.org/datasets/123"
spec:
  replicas: 1
  template:

          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"
              limits:
              cpu: "200m"
              memory: "256Mi"
```

- How to handle exceptions per-namespace while preserving governance?

## Why This Is Asked

Tests practical, early-stage container security habits beyond theory, focusing on concrete checks a junior engineer can implement in CI.

## Key Concepts

- Non-root runtime users in Dockerfiles
- Pinning base images (tags or digests, not latest)
- HEALTHCHECK presence
- Minimizing RUN layers via chained commands and restricted apt usage

## Code Example

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import glob,os,re
for f in glob.glob('**/Dockerfile', recursive=True):
  s=open(f).read()
  if 'USER 0' in s or 'USER root' in s:
    print(f+': non-root USER not set')
  if re.search(r'FROM\s+.*:latest', s, re.M):
    print(f+': base image pinned is missing')
  if 'HEALTHCHECK' not in s:
    print(f+': HEALTHCHECK missing')
```

- What trade-offs exist between strict pinning and CI cache efficiency, and how would you mitigate them?

## Why This Is Asked

apiVersion: templates.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: ConstraintTemplate
metadata:
  name: k8ssecuredcontainers
spec:
  crd:
    spec:
      names:
        kind: K8sSecuredContainers

    - target: admission.k8s.gatekeeper.sh

apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata:
  name: require-otel-tracing
spec:
 rules:

     resources:
       kinds: [Deployment]
   validate:
     message: "Deployment must have otel.instrumentation=enabled annotation"
     anyPattern:
     - metadata:

             - name: "otel-collector"

             containers:
             - env:
